annotations.title: Look up a Hebrew or Greek word

description: A dictionary entry for a Hebrew or Greek word given as a lemma, an inflected form, a Strong's number or a transliteration: lemma, Strong's number, part of speech, gloss, definition, how often it occurs in the Hebrew Bible or Greek New Testament, every verse it occurs in (page with offset and limit; default all), and example verses with links. Add "in" ("Genesis 1") to count and find it inside one book, chapter or passage. Example: q "H430" in "Genesis 1". If empty, try the Strong's number or the dictionary form.

in.description: A book, chapter or verses to count within, e.g. "Genesis 1".

limit.description: Occurrences to list. Default: all of them.

offset.description: Skip this many occurrences in the list. Default 0.

q.description: Lemma, Strong's number or surface form: "H430", "G1510", "λόγος", "בראשית", "elohim".

name: lookup_lemma
title: Look up a Hebrew or Greek word
